title: Membership Tenure Reduction on Northgate Delivery & Installation Parts Kits
content:
A tenure reduction lowers the kit price on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment, following the whole months from the opened date of the membership presented on the purchase being delivered to today, as Northgate Memberships records that opened date.

| Whole months from the presented membership's opened date to today | Reduction off the price of each kit |
|---|---|
| 180 or more | $4.00 |
| 96 to 179 | $2.00 |
| Fewer than 96 | No reduction |

The reduction comes off the price of each kit itself, so every amount worked out from the price of a kit is worked out from the lowered price.

## Band edges

| Whole months | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 180 | $4.00 |
| 179 | $2.00 |
| 96 | $2.00 |
| 95 | None |

**Hypothetical member.** A membership opened 200 whole months ago lowers a $39.00 kit price to $35.00.
